items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: The interviewee discusses Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly. Mildred is introduced by the interviewer as Edna Kelly's daughter. The interviewee does not mention Mildred, nor does the text indicate any personal interaction or relationship between the interviewee and Mildred.

ctx.x: Yeah, I can tell you... I was asking about the musicians that you all played with, and she said, oh, it was Joe Rene. I remember him. Yeah, because I used to go in his house all the time. After he got that plan, I'd just... I would stick with him, you know? Still want to see her. I haven't seen her in a long time. I've got 15, 20 years almost.

Let's see. 525... 6093. It's 1204 Echelon. She lives there with her daughter, Mildred. Mildred. Oh, yeah. And she could probably have been a baby almost when you... that first time you were talking about when you went around and you heard your daughter playing the fight. Mildred, I want Mildred, but... Mildred was born in 1919. George would have been 19 years old when she was born. Actually, George was probably a little bit... I think she was a baby then. Yeah, or may not have even been born even. Maybe even...…

Well, we used to play dances. We played dances. If I can remember that. You got something... I got to dig my mind now. Because he just... he didn't regularly say he played with the band. Studies. We used to iron. Yeah. We used to iron, yeah. Let's see if I had something to think about now. Well, we used to play that. Oh, I know he never played at the colony. He'd incorporate all over with us. Because we had a fella. Zeb DeMorris played at the colony at that time.
